reviews.text: I can’t say enough to commend Alejandro for dog training. He took our standard poodle who was all over the place, and shaped her into a polished, well trained, and well mannered proper pup. She is so different and it’s so amazing! She’s much happier too and with far less anxiety. It truly has made our home so much better. We will definitely be taking her back for boarding when we leave town and we know she can’t wait to go back to dog paradise

Alejandro worked wonders with our dog Indy! I really appreciated the type of training that he provided was hands-on instruction that empowered my wife and I to start training the dog ourselves. He showed us cues and behaviors that that we were enabling bad behavior with Indy. I appreciated he came to us and trained both us and Indy in the things WE needed to do to enforce good behavior and correct the bad.

We couldn’t recommend Pupsties more highly! Alejandro has been an incredible dog trainer and our go-to boarding person whenever we travel. He is extremely kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about the dogs he works with.

One thing we really appreciate is how responsive he is — he always replies quickly and is happy to give advice or answer questions whenever we need help. While our dog is boarding with him, he keeps excellent communication with us by sending regular pictures and videos, which gives us so much peace of mind while we’re away.

It’s clear that he truly loves what he does, and our dog is always happy and well cared for with him. We are so grateful to have found someone we trust completely. Highly recommend!

Working with Alejandro has been an absolute game-changer for our family. You can tell immediately that he has a deep passion for what he does—he isn't just training a dog; he’s truly dedicated to making your life easier. He was incredibly patient and understanding with our 12-week-old puppy, taking the time to get to the root of the behavioral issues rather than just treating the symptoms. Me and my husband were at the point with our puppy, biting us to where we would hide in the restroom from him. Using his exercises has totally turned this around for us and we are able to be near our dog in peace without feeling like we are going to get attacked by puppy teeth. He is so informative and walks you through everything step-by-step, giving you the confidence and tools you need to handle unwanted behaviors. We finally feel like we have a clear path forward. If you want a trainer who genuinely cares about your progress, look no further than Alejandro!
Alejandro was very acomadating taught me helpful tricks to help me train my dog :)
Alejandro took excellent care of my King Charles Cavalier for six days. His service is professional and he goes above and beyond in all aspects of boarding your furry loved ones.

Alejandro is absolutely amazing! My dog Gigi has stayed here multiple times and always comes home happy. She loves being part of the pack, especially the pack walks with Alejandro’s own dogs. Alejandro is patient, caring, and a fantastic trainer. He helped Gigi with her pulling tendencies and even recommended a better leash, which has made walks so much easier for us. I always feel confident leaving her here knowing she’s safe, well cared for, and having the best time. Highly recommend!

Incredible experience! We have a 1.4 year old husky/gsp rescue pup who likes to pull hard on walks, and has started showing signs of aggression like barking intensely and attempting to bite guests in our home. Needless to say we needed some serious help!

Alejandro agreed to take on our pup and he taught us some extremely helpful techniques. He seemed to know exactly what our pup needed and what we ourselves needed to learn in order to get our power back over the dog. He gave us clear and direct instructions which was super helpful. He’s also just an all around nice guy and a great teacher.

We stuck with it and just around 3 weeks later, we’ve seen amazing progress, way more than we ever expected to make in such short time. Our pup listens better, and walks have become SO much more enjoyable with him. He has also improved behavior with guests in our home, with our guidance, and has improved in small areas we haven’t even trained on. He respects us so much more in general.

We absolutely loved working Alejandro and are so grateful for his help. He gave us something we were beginning to lose. Hope!

Alejandro was incredibly helpful and gave us the tools and confidence to train our two crazy puppies. He listens to all of your problems and comes up with a plan to help you overcome them. Highly recommend Alejandro for any of your dog troubles!

I can't say enough great things about Alejandro and his dog psychology services! I have two boxers who used to go absolutely crazy on walks -- constantly pulling on their leashes and making walks stressful for both me and them.

Alejandro came to my house to observe how I interacted with my dogs on our walks. After watching us, he explained why my actions were actually encouraging their pulling and gave me clear, practical advice on how to correct my behavior. It was eye-opening to realize that my own habits were a big part of the problem!

With his guidance, I learned how to communicate better with my dogs and establish calm, structured walks. The difference has been amazing -- my boxers are so much more relaxed and responsive now.

I'm incredibly grateful for Alejandro's help and the lessons I've learned. If you're struggling with your dogs' behavior, I highly recommend working with him. It truly changed our walks for the better!

10 out of 10 recommend Alejandro for all your dog training needs. After two sessions, my dogs are in such a different place with thier walking and just overall behavior. Alejandro gave my spouse and I constructive feedback on behaviors we didn’t realize could be changed in a matter of fact and practical way and helped us to feel like we run the house again rather than our pups. Alejandro is so knowledgeable in what he does and helped us to not only understand how to change the behaviors but why our dogs do them in the first place. Overall, I highly recommend Alejandro for all your dog training needs!

Alejandro is in deed a dog whisperer. He thought me and my kids how to teach our 8mo pug puppy along with our other dog, 3yo Maltese. He knows dogs so well that all you need is a few hours with him. Our pug went from completely wild to “no sofa” and tamed in a couple of hours, it’s like a miracle. Alejandro is also kind, and very easy to talk to which made it even more enjoyable.

Alejandro is so great to work with! His confidence with our pups gave us confidence. Part therapist part dog trainer, he has a very no non-sense approach that really clicked for me and our dogs. I found his techniques easy to apply and continue to practice after our sessions. Our dog was so calm and content after sessions. We are very grateful for the progress we’ve made and eager to see what else we will learn.

We recently boarded our foster dog, Brownie, with Alejandro @ Pupsties.  Not only did he board him, he taught him valuable lessons while in his care.  We highly recommend him with the care and training of your furever pups.  Alejandro can also make you become a better dog owner.  Best in Houston.  Thank you, Alejandro.

Alejandro did a great job training and looking after my dog while I was out of town. Felt totally comfortable and he was responsive as well as sent great pics/videos to keep me updated on my dog’s stay. 5 stars!
Good Job!!!

Our dog Apollo stayed with Alejandro at Pupsties for almost two weeks and had an amazing time! We got fun video and photo updates daily of how well he was integrated into the pack and making new friends. We were assured the whole time Apollo was being cared for as if he were their own - what more could you want! Staying with Alejandro was perfect for our high energy pup who needs more structure than you would get from the big business kennels. We highly recommend Pupsties for boarding!

In 2 sessions our dog, who was hard to control walking and especially when encountering other dogs, is more attentive and in control! Alejandro worked with us, to teach us how to work with and control our dog and it worked. He is so patient and knowledgeable and followed up with us in between sessions and after. Would highly recommend!

I’m so glad I found Alejandro! My dog is very reactive when he’s on a leash and was always pulling me on our walks. It was such a night and day difference after my first training session with Alejandro. I really appreciate his training methods and how he focuses on a dog’s psychology. Alejandro was able to pick up on so many of my dog’s cues that I had missed.

I also really appreciate that Alejandro isn’t a pushy salesman like other training facilities I inquired with.

Really excited to see the progression my dog makes  with Pupsties :)

Wow! I wish I had found pupsties sooner!!! The level of care and expertise is top notch. I have tried multiple dog classes, boarding training and training at dog daycare centers. My doxies range in age(15, 6, 3) and each have their challenge. Dachshund parents this is your sign to book. Pupsties dog training is on another level, and you will get results that will last. Pupsties provides flexible scheduling and great service.

We rescued a dog that showed a lot of aggression towards other dogs. We had not owned a dog before so were out of our league, but Alejandro taught us in a couple of lessons several effective techniques that have helped a great deal to calm the dog and regain control. He also helped us understand how to do this safely, and more importantly gave us hope that over time we could overcome the behavioral issues. I would absolutely recommend Alejandro whether you have significant issues or just want a more enjoyable time with your dog.

I have two dogs and they are a team!  I needed someone who could help me train both of them at the same time in their environment.  He immediately identified the problematic behavior and gave me a training tip.  He practiced it on my dogs and then taught me.  We took my dogs on a walk and he showed me how to keep them engaged with me and how to notice their reaction to other people and dogs, teaching me tips on how to keep everyone calm. His knowledge on the different reactions and mental aspects of dogs was impressive.

He gave me great insight to their mental state and helped me think like a dog! He was awesome and I would highly recommend him.

We had the most amazing experience with Alejandro. This is the first time leaving our Goldendoodle, and could have not been happier. He stay in a loving, and caring environment.
We received videos and photos everyday which my kids loved. Alejandro even share a few tips with us.
Loki was able to see the new location and he absolutely loved it. Lots of grounds to run around. He stayed with them for a week. We will definitely leave Loki with them again.

Highly recommend!
The training was informative, detailed, and effective.
This picture is hours after the training. Before we couldn’t even have them in the same room.
Alejandro is truly impressive: he helped us to take the behavior of our 2 dogs under control only within 2 sessions. Very effective! Totally recommend!

I really appreciate the training today, as he truly take into account the reality of both the family’s and the dog’s routine in an individualized way. I can’t wait to apply with Buddy everything I’ve learned! Thank you Alejandro!

Our neighbors recommended Alejandro with Pupsties and the results we achieved were nothing less than amazing in only two weeks and two sessions! Working with Alejandro, we transformed our two dogs' behavior, addressing walking issues, excessive barking at visitors, and toy-fighting. Alejandro’s expertise, patience and accountability are unmatched. Our home is already more peaceful thanks to his effective training techniques. Highly recommend for any dog behavior problems or general dog training!

I had a great experience with Alejandro. He saved my life with my dog.
Since I was with Cookie, I was not feeling a pleasure to go out with her. She was hurting me, stopping all the time, barking at everything.
After Alejandro trained her, I had much more pleasure on all upcoming walks I have with her. I did not know how good was to be able to go out with my dog.
Thanks Alejandro...

I can't recommend Alejandro enough! Our Cavalier was basically running the house...she would escape out the door at every opportunity, make a ruckus every time we took her for a walk, and overall just not respect anything or anyone. That's not the case anymore...it's like we have a whole different, and unbelievably more polite, dog. Alejandro made the process so simple and yet effective...and he also explained why she acts the way she does, and how the method works, which helps understand and apply it. So worth it!!
The very best dog psychologist since Cesar Millan!!!
We're thrilled with the excellent training from Panchita and Zooky. Thank you, Mr. Alex, your experience and quality of service are unmatched... 100% recommended

We cannot say enough great things about Alejandro! We have two dogs, Lincoln and Quincy, and thanks to Alejandro’s training, they are happier and better-behaved than ever. More importantly, Alejandro didn’t just train our dogs—he trained us to be better dog owners. His patience, expertise, and personalized approach truly made a difference in our home. We’ve noticed such a positive change in our dogs and our routines right away. If you’re looking for a trainer who genuinely cares and gets results, Alejandro is the one!

We highly recommend Pupsties for both training and boarding! Alejandro is an exceptional dog behaviorist who truly helped us get to the root of our dog’s overexcitement. We had previously tried various other training programs - both group classes and board-and-train options - but none were as effective. After just two sessions with Pupsties, we saw noticeable improvements. During home visits, Alejandro identified issues we hadn’t even noticed and offered solutions to address them. We’re incredibly grateful for Alejandro’s expertise!

From chaos to a love story ♥️
